description: Ordered operation lists over chats, messages, summaries, deletes and imports. Each case starts from an empty database and runs ops in order: expected[i] is the result of ops[i], so later reads see earlier writes. Pseudo-ops: reopen closes and reopens the database; sql runs raw statements on the file; schema dumps sqlite_master. A timestamp the call defaulted to now is written as {"$any":"number"}.
